messages:
maria: Hey team — high-severity from AcmeProd: their tool-invoke endpoint (action-call v1) started returning 500s around 09:12 UTC. Customer impact: chat flow fails when the assistant calls a payment tool.

maria: Quick summary from the customer: payload arrives with a null in the \"amount\" field even though they set it in the UI. They only see it in production, not in staging.

devon: Can you paste the API error/logs?

maria: Pasting truncated log from our gateway (redacted):

```
[09:12:21] ERROR request_id=32a1b func=ActionRouter::invoke - tool handler failed: validation_error: required field 'amount' missing
stack: ActionHandler::validate -> serde_json::Error at line 1 column 123
request.payload: {"user_id":"acme-123","tool":"charge_card","args":{"amount":null,"currency":"USD"}}
```

samir: Interesting — the payload shows amount:null. Do we have any transformers or middleware that coerce empty strings to null on prod only?

kevin: Not intentionally. We did deploy a tiny SDK change yesterday (js-client v0.17.2) that alters how form fields are encoded for function/tool calls. Could be related.

maria: Customer says they updated from our SDK v0.16.x -> v0.17.2 last night. They repro'd by calling our REST API directly and saw the same null. So might be client or server handling differences.

devon: Repro steps I ran locally against staging (no SDK change):
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/actions -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"tool":"charge_card","args":{"amount":"100","currency":"USD"}}'
-> staging returned 200 and args arrived as strings.

2) I tried to call using node SDK v0.17.2 (quick script) and saw amount:null before it hits our gateway. So this looks client-side. Script: 
```js
const rcd = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY});
rcd.action.invoke('charge_card', { amount: '100', currency: 'USD' });
```

samir: If SDK is sending null, maybe there's a bad JSON encode step when converting to typed args. @kevin can you check the SDK diff?

kevin: Looking at the changelist: we added a small optimization for formData -> JSON conversion to coerce numeric-looking strings to numbers, but there's a bug: empty/invalid numeric coercion returns null instead of leaving the original string in some code paths (line shown below).

```diff
-  out[argKey] = maybeNumber(value)
+  out[argKey] = coerceNumeric(value)
```

coerceNumeric('100') => 100 (ok) but coerceNumeric('100\n') => null (bug). That could explain intermittent nulls if input has trailing whitespace from the UI.

maria: Customer says their UI sometimes includes invisible non-breaking spaces in the amount field (copy/paste flow). That fits.

devon: Mitigation options:
- short-term: server-side validation change to treat null amount as invalid 400 with clearer message and not 500. Also add a defensive canonicalization step that preserves original string when possible.
- medium-term: issue hotfix to SDK to revert coercion behavior and release v0.17.3.
- immediate workaround for customer: pin SDK to v0.16.9 or call REST directly with JSON body that ensures proper quoting.

eng-runtime-oncall: I'm going to push a quick gateway change to avoid a 500. Will convert validation_error to 400 and include original raw payload in error for debugging. Deploying canary now.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1057 (priority P2). Linked to customer case CS-8892.

kevin: I'll prepare a 0.17.3 patch to remove the coercion and add tests for whitespace-handling. ETA 3 hours.

samir: Also add a server-side log metric for number_of_null_tool_args so we can alert if this spikes.

maria: I told Acme SRE: pin their SDK to v0.16.9 and we will notify when v0.17.3 is available. They accepted the workaround.

devon: Final checklist:
- [x] canary gateway change to return 400 (eng-runtime-oncall)
- [x] create incident and link to CS (support-bot)
- [ ] SDK hotfix PR (kevin)
- [ ] add server metric and alert (samir)
- [ ] follow-up note to customer when SDK ship (maria)

kevin: PR opened: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4122 — rolling dev release to CI. I included test cases for trailing whitespace and NBSP.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll keep thread updated and close when customer confirms recovery. :thumbsup:
